name: Lifting 2D GAN to 3D Radiance Field
definition: A method to distill 3D knowledge from a pretrained 2D GAN (StyleGAN2) by jointly optimizing a shared conditional NeRF and latent codes to lift 2D generated images into a 3D object NeRF, enabling the generation of novel 3D objects with arbitrary poses for training data augmentation.
summary: Lifting 2D GAN to 3D Radiance Field distills 2D GAN knowledge into a shared NeRF using Generative Latent Optimization to generate photorealistic 3D objects with arbitrary poses.
